course_name_en: Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering and Electronics

learning_outcomes.text: Students use the subject-specific terminology confidently.
apply the fundamental physical laws of electrical engineering and their interconnections.
recognize the boundary conditions of the respective physical laws.
select the correct laws to describe a given problem.
master calculations with the corresponding units.
master methods for calculating DC and AC networks.
calculate simple electric fields using electric field quantities.
calculate simple magnetic circuits using magnetic field quantities.
identify simple circuits with a transistor.
recognize basic circuits with an operational amplifier and can calculate them.
name the functional principle of various electric motors.
evaluate measuring instruments for electrical quantities and handle them correctly in the respective application.
solve problems also in a small group, communicating and explaining technical content.
independently and collaboratively delve into topics of electrical engineering and discuss them competently.
recognize their own learning style when learning.
understand how their own learning style can be improved and how collaboration with others can be improved.

syllabus_topics: DC circuits: voltage, current, Ohm's law, series connection, parallel connection, Kirchhoff's laws, equivalent voltage source, equivalent current source, work, power, power matching, network calculation
Electric field: electric field quantities, capacitance of capacitors, energy in the electrostatic field, forces in the electrostatic field

Magnetic field: magnetic field quantities, inductance of the coil, Ampere's law (Durchflutungsgesetz), magnetic circuit, magnetic energy of the coil, forces in the magnetic field, Faraday's law of induction, self-induction
AC circuit: sinusoidal variation of electrical quantities, phasor and complex representation, basic AC circuits, power, AC network calculation, transformers
Three-phase system: star connection, delta connection, power, symmetrical load, asymmetrical load
Electrical machines: DC machine, asynchronous machine, synchronous machine
Semiconductors: diode, transistor, operational amplifier, fundamentals of electronic circuits
